tagline.en: 1960s roads along the foot of the Kowloon hills, strung together into a trunk route with traffic lights in it
tagline.zh: 沿九龙山脚铺开的 1960 年代道路，串成一条仍有交通灯的干线

start.en: The Kwai Chung interchange, where Ching Cheung Road meets Kwai Chung Road (Route 5)
start.zh: 葵涌交汇处，呈祥道与葵涌道（5号干线）相接

end.en: Wan Po Road in Tseung Kwan O, at Po Lai Road — only the stretch of Wan Po Road north of there is part of the route
end.zh: 将军澳环保大道蓬莱路口——环保大道只有蓬莱路以北一段属于本干线

en: Route 7 crosses the north of Kowloon from Kwai Chung to Tseung Kwan O, about 17.6 km. It is a chain of older roads — Ching Cheung Road, Lung Cheung Road, Kwun Tong Road, a short piece of Lei Yue Mun Road, Tseung Kwan O Road, the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel and its approach road, and the northern end of Wan Po Road — and it passes Lai Chi Kok, Sham Shui Po, Kowloon Tong, Wong Tai Sin, Diamond Hill, Ngau Tau Kok and Kwun Tong on the way.

Ching Cheung Road and Lung Cheung Road follow the foothills along the northern edge of the city, and the road climbs steeply near the Lion Rock Tunnel exit. Through Kwun Tong it is a town road on viaducts and underpasses. It meets Route 1 at the Lion Rock Tunnel, Route 2 at the Kwun Tong Bypass and Tate's Cairn Tunnel, Route 3 at the Tsing Kwai Highway, Route 5 at both ends and Route 8 at the Tsing Sha Highway.

It is the odd one among the trunk routes. Until Route 6 is complete it is the only one with no expressway section at all, and it has the fewest chainage markers. In Kwun Tong it turns through right angles at the Tseung Kwan O Road and Lei Yue Mun Road junctions, and several junctions on Kwun Tong Road are still controlled by traffic lights — two of them with pedestrian crossings, two of the three places on Hong Kong's trunk routes where people cross on foot at a signal.
zh: 7号干线横贯九龙北部，由葵涌至将军澳，全长约 17.6 公里。它由一连串较旧的道路组成——呈祥道、龙翔道、观塘道、一小段鲤鱼门道、将军澳道、将军澳隧道及其隧道公路，以及环保大道北端——沿途经过荔枝角、深水埗、九龙塘、黄大仙、钻石山、牛头角和观塘。
呈祥道和龙翔道沿市区北缘的山脚而行，近狮子山隧道出口一段坡度明显变陡。到了观塘，它变成一条以天桥和下通道穿行的市区道路。它在狮子山隧道与1号干线相交，在观塘绕道及大老山隧道与2号干线相交，在青葵公路与3号干线相交，两端均与5号干线相接，并在青沙公路与8号干线相交。
在各条干线之中，它是个异类。在6号干线全线通车之前，它是唯一完全没有快速公路路段的干线，路标也最少。在观塘，将军澳道与鲤鱼门道交界处有两个 90 度直角弯，观塘道多个路口至今仍以交通灯控制——其中两处设有行人过路灯，是全港干线上仅有的三处让行人在灯号下直接过马路的地点中的两处。

en: Kwun Tong, in the 1960s the main manufacturing district of Hong Kong, needed a way west that did not go through the crowded city. Kwun Tong Road opened in the 1950s; Lung Cheung Road, reported at the time as the Kowloon by-pass road, opened on 24 June 1961, and Ching Cheung Road followed in November 1966, the two together running along the hills north of developed Kowloon towards Tsuen Wan and Kwai Chung.

When the second-generation route numbers were drawn up in 1974 the corridor became Route 4. Kwun Tong Road between Ngau Tau Kok and Tsui Ping was rebuilt at the end of the 1970s for the MTR's Kwun Tong line, with flyovers and underpasses, though traffic lights were kept at some junctions; the line runs under Lung Cheung Road between Wong Tai Sin and Choi Hung.

The route reached Tseung Kwan O in 1990. The Tseung Kwan O Tunnel had been planned from November 1982, deferred and cut to a single tube in the 1984 spending cuts, restored to twin tubes in 1986, and opened on 9 November 1990. The roundabout outside it on Tseung Kwan O Tunnel Road, a bottleneck from the start, was rebuilt as a grade-separated interchange, finished in 2006.

In the renumbering of 31 January 2004 the old Route 4 became Route 7. When the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel opened on 11 December 2022, the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel's toll was abolished and Route 7 became toll-free end to end.
zh: 1960 年代，观塘是香港的主要工业区，需要一条不经拥挤市区的西行通道。观塘道于 1950 年代通车；龙翔道——当时报章称为“九龙绕道”——于 1961 年 6 月 24 日通车，呈祥道则于 1966 年 11 月通车，两者沿已发展九龙以北的山坡，通往荃湾和葵涌。
1974 年订定第二代干线编号时，这条走廊编为4号干线。1970 年代末，因兴建地铁观塘线，观塘道牛头角至翠屏一段改建，加设行车天桥及下通道，但部分路口仍保留交通灯；观塘线在黄大仙至彩虹之间就建在龙翔道之下。
1990 年，这条干线伸展到将军澳。将军澳隧道自 1982 年 11 月开始规划，1984 年因削减公共开支而押后并缩减为单管，1986 年恢复为双管，1990 年 11 月 9 日通车。隧道外将军澳隧道公路上的环岛自通车起便是樽颈，其后改建为分层互通立交，于 2006 年完工。
2004 年 1 月 31 日重新编号时，原4号干线改称7号干线。2022 年 12 月 11 日将军澳—蓝田隧道通车，将军澳隧道同日取消收费，7号干线从此全程免费。

en: Route 7 was built by the government in pieces over more than thirty years and has never had a route-wide budget. The one piece with a published cost is the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel, about HK$600 million, built with public money and owned by the government. It charged HK$3 from 1990 until 2022, with franchised buses exempted from February 2019; the rest of the route was always free.
zh: 7号干线由政府在三十多年间分段修建，从来没有全线预算。唯一有公开造价的是将军澳隧道，约 6 亿港元，由政府投资兴建并拥有。它自 1990 年起收费 3 元，2019 年 2 月起专营巴士免费，至 2022 年全面取消收费；干线其余路段一向免费。

en: This is the route where a trunk road behaves like a city street. Westbound, the driver has to turn right off Tseung Kwan O Road onto Kwun Tong Road; going straight on leads onto the Kwun Tong Bypass instead. Eastbound, the turn is left from Lei Yue Mun Road onto Tseung Kwan O Road, and going straight on leads towards Lam Tin and the Eastern Harbour Crossing. The Tseung Kwan O Tunnel is limited to 70 km/h.
zh: 在这条干线上，主干道的表现就像一条市区街道。西行时，须由将军澳道右转入观塘道，直行则会驶上观塘绕道；东行时，须由鲤鱼门道左转入将军澳道，直行则会前往蓝田及东区海底隧道。将军澳隧道限速每小时 70 公里。

why.en: No route-wide cost exists: the route is a set of roads built separately between the 1950s and 1990 and numbered together later. The Tseung Kwan O Tunnel is the only piece with a published figure, below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：它由 1950 年代至 1990 年间分别兴建的道路组成，后来才合并编号。只有将军澳隧道有公开数字，见下。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 将军澳隧道, citing contemporary Hong Kong press reports of the November 1990 opening

value.en: The Hong Kong government. The Tseung Kwan O Tunnel was government-funded and is government-owned, run by a management contractor; it was tolled until 11 December 2022.
value.zh: 香港政府。将军澳隧道由政府投资兴建并拥有，由管理承办商营运，收费至 2022 年 12 月 11 日为止。

figures.source: English and Chinese Wikipedia, Route 7 (Hong Kong) / 7號幹線

timeline.en: Lung Cheung Road opens on 24 June.
Ching Cheung Road opens in November.
The corridor is numbered Route 4 in the second-generation route system.
timeline.zh: 第二代干线编号系统将这条走廊编为4号干线。

timeline.en: Spending cuts defer the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel and reduce it to a single tube; twin tubes are restored in 1986.
timeline.zh: 削减公共开支，将军澳隧道押后兴建并缩减为单管；1986 年恢复双管方案。

timeline.en: The Tseung Kwan O Tunnel opens on 9 November, extending the route to Tseung Kwan O.
timeline.zh: 11 月 9 日，将军澳隧道通车，干线延伸至将军澳。

timeline.en: Route 4 is renumbered Route 7 on 31 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 31 日，4号干线改编为7号干线。

timeline.en: The grade-separated interchange replacing the Tseung Kwan O Tunnel Road roundabout is completed.
timeline.zh: 取代将军澳隧道公路环岛的分层互通立交完工。

timeline.en: The Tseung Kwan O Tunnel toll is abolished on 11 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 11 日，将军澳隧道取消收费。
